dedupe_keys.name: irene ae9 ap9 spm radiation belt and space plasma specification models

description: IRENE-AE9/AP9/SPM is a set of climatological models of the fluxes of energetic electrons (AE9), energetic protons (AP9) and space plasma (SPM) in near-Earth space, known together as the International Radiation Environment Near Earth. The Air Force Research Laboratory maintains it for space system design, mission planning and other uses that need a statistical specification of the radiation environment, as a successor to the legacy AE8 and AP8 models. The site documents energy and spatial coverage, architecture, source datasets, run modes, recommended time sampling, known issues and independent validations. Version 1.58.001, current in March 2025, is approved for public release with distribution unlimited. Format and access: a Windows distribution package with graphical and command-line versions, user's guide, documentation, licence and sample files, downloaded after logging in with a public AE9AP9 account. Licence: US government Distribution A release; free. Caveats: it is a climatology, not a forecast, and the site lists known limitations. It supports hazard exposure analysis of satellites and GNSS constellations to radiation. Related catalogue records are the AE-8 and AP-8 radiation belt models and the British Antarctic Survey radiation belt model.
